aspects.trouble: Owes More Favors Than He's Owed

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: LINK ESTABLISHED — LOW BAND

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Handler, Riptide-3, checking in. I'm inside the Undertow den — gutted
   cargo hulk on pylons, low-tide access only. Walked in dry. Won't
   stay that way.

   Juno's here. On her feet, arms wrapped around herself, won't look
   at the door. This isn't a standard extraction brief, Handler. This
   is your sister. Say so if I'm wrong about what we're doing tonight.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Vane's laying out terms. Fifty thousand credits by dawn, or the
   regulator comes out of her chest 'however it comes out' — his
   words, not mine. No anesthetic if we're late. Given what that
   chrome does for her lungs down in the deep sectors, that's not
   repossession. That's a body bag with a payment schedule attached.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
There's a wrinkle. Vane says Undertow's got a job needs doing
   tonight — corp remittance barge, sitting fat at low tide. Clear it
   for them, debt's gone, nobody's chrome comes out of anybody. He's
   watching me while he says it. Wants an answer, Handler.

choices.text: "Tell him fifty thousand isn't the only thing that leaves this room broken."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "We're reasonable people. Ask him what this job actually is."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Take the job. We don't have four hours to spend talking."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Hold on — I'm calling in a favor first."

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: OUTBOUND CALL — ENCRYPTED

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Made the call. Owed me from a long way back — they're on standby if
   tonight goes bad. Doesn't buy us a minute here. It's just something
   in the bank for later.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
That landed. Vane's jaw is doing something ugly, but he's giving
   ground on the clock — four hours, hard stop, and his crew's
   counting it too now, so it's real. Doesn't feel like a man who's
   going to forget I said it, though.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: FLAG SET: THREATENED_COLLECTIVE

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CLOCK: 4 HOURS TO DAWN

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text: That did not land the way I wanted—

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: WARNING: HOSTILE CONTACT — 2x UNDERTOW MUSCLE

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: COMBAT RESOLVED — HOSTILES DOWN

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Both down. Vane's not smiling anymore, but Juno took an elbow to
   the ribs before I got to her — she's hurt, she's upright, and
   she's looking at me like I just made this worse. No extension
   offered. Dawn, full stop.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CLOCK: DAWN — NO EXTENSION

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: STRESS APPLIED — MEAT +1, NERVES +1

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
They had the numbers on us in that room, Handler. I took a beating
   I didn't need to take. Juno's worse for it too — took a hit meant
   for me. We're walking out with nothing but the clock, and it's not
   being generous about it.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CLOCK: DAWN — NO EXTENSION

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
He's listening. There's a barge job — corp remittance platform,
   underhull access at low tide, ripe for tonight. Clear it clean,
   debt's forgiven, nobody's chrome comes out. Four hours on the
   clock, starting now.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: FLAG SET: JOB_SWAP

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CLOCK: 4 HOURS TO DAWN

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
He's not buying reasonable, but he's not calling for the anesthetic
   tray either. Two hours, no job offer. He wants to watch us scramble
   for cash on our own dime. Charming guy, your creditor.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CLOCK: 2 HOURS TO DAWN

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Copy. Taking the job — Vane's already waving his people over to
   brief me on the barge. No haggling, no extension banked. We do
   this clean or we don't do it at all.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CLOCK: 4 HOURS TO DAWN

messages.speaker: data
messages.text:
TARGET: Corp remittance clearing platform, open-water mooring
GUARD ROTATION: 4-minute intervals, underhull hatch blind 90 sec/pass
ALARM GRID: Standard corp mesh, ledger-side trip
TIDE WINDOW: Closing — underhull access floods in nine minutes

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Handler, I'm not alone out here. Local fixer caught wind we're
   moving on the barge — goes by Ratchet, says he knows this hull's
   blind spots better than the guards do. Offering to help carry,
   split the load 'so we're not both holding fifty grand if this goes
   sideways.' Practical guy. I trust the practical ones less than the
   ones who stay home, but he's not wrong about the math.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Small thing — Ratchet clocked a second patrol I hadn't logged and
   pulled me back before I walked into their sightline. Didn't have
   to. Didn't ask for a cut of the take to do it either. Noting that,
   Handler, because guys like that don't usually last long down here.

choices.text: "Go quiet. Hack the ledger, take exactly what we're owed."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Blow the vault. Grab it and go."
choices.speaker: player

messages.text:

   blind spots better than the guards do. Offering to help carry,
   split the load 'so we're not both holding fifty grand if this goes
   sideways.' Practical guy. I trust the practical ones less than the
   ones who stay home, but he's not wrong about the math.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Also — Vane's people are out on the water. Not helping. Watching.
   Undertow's got skin in this now, so no improvising, Handler.
   They're counting on clean.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Small thing — Ratchet clocked a second patrol I hadn't logged and
   pulled me back before I walked into their sightline. Didn't have
   to. Didn't ask for a cut of the take to do it either. Noting that,
   Handler, because guys like that don't usually last long down here.

choices.text: "Go quiet. Hack the ledger, take exactly what we're owed."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Blow the vault. Grab it and go."
choices.speaker: player

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: LEDGER ACCESS — SIPHON IN PROGRESS...

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
In. Quiet. Fifty thousand, clean transfer — nobody on this hull
   even twitched.

messages.speaker: data
messages.text: TIDE WINDOW: 3 minutes remaining

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
That took longer than I wanted it to. Tide's turning under us.
   We move now.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: ALARM TRIPPED — LEDGER FLAGGED SIPHON

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text: Every light on this hull just turned red. Guards inbound, Handler.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Handled. Money's ours, but that alarm didn't stay local — somebody
   heard it who isn't Undertow.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: STRESS APPLIED — MEAT +1

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Took a hit clearing them. We've got the money. I've got a limp and
   a countdown that isn't slowing down for either.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CHARGES SET

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Vault's open. Grabbing and moving — this brings every guard on the
   platform, and it's going straight up the wire to corp security
   proper. We just made this loud in a way we don't get to walk back.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: FLAG SET: BURNED_CORP_SECTOR

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Ratchet's got the case open. Question's how much we take before
   this window shuts.

choices.text: "Take more than fifty. We might need the cushion."
choices.speaker: player

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
More zeros than the number Vane gave us. Ratchet's counting it
   twice, doesn't say much. Just looks at it a beat longer than he
   needs to.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Fifty, exact, case shut. Cleanest exit we've got — but it means
   zero margin if anything downstream goes wrong.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: TRANSIT — FLOODED CAUSEWAY — TIDE RISING

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Handler, we're mid-tunnel, water's climbing our boots, and I don't
   like the way our footsteps are echoing back at us in here.

choices.text: "Split up — Ratchet takes the money ahead, you hold the line."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Dump the extra credits. Lighten the load, shorten this."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Call in that favor. We need it now."
choices.speaker: player

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Corp chrome up ahead, not Undertow. They want their money back, and
   they brought the kind of gear that doesn't ask nice.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Ratchet's already got his back to the wall, hand on his own blade —
   watching the water, not the enemy. Filing that away.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT — MANDATORY

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Undertow vests. Vane's boys — 'checking on their investment,' one of
   them just said. Didn't sound like a courtesy call.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Ratchet's already got his back to the wall, hand on his own blade —
   watching the water, not the enemy. Filing that away.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT — MANDATORY

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Don't recognize the colors. Not corp, not Undertow — somebody else
   clocked we're carrying fifty grand and decided to make it their
   problem.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Ratchet's already got his back to the wall, hand on his own blade —
   watching the water, not the enemy. Filing that away.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT — MANDATORY

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: COMBAT RESOLVED — HOSTILES DOWN

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Clear. Everyone's still standing, mostly. Ratchet's fine, still
   holding his half of the case. We're bruised, we're wet, and we're
   still in the black. Moving to the meet.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CRITICAL — STRESS APPLIED, PARTIAL LOSS

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Handler — they got into the case. Some of it's gone, and I'm not
   walking as fast as I was five minutes ago. We're going into the
   meet worse off than we came in here.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: RENDEZVOUS POINT — RATCHET: NO CONTACT

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text: Handler, meet point's empty. Ratchet's not here.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CORRECTION — MULTIPLE CONTACTS, VANE'S COLORS

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Scratch that. He's here. So's Vane's crew, standing around him like
   they've been waiting a while. He's not tied up, Handler. He's just
   standing there. This wasn't a snatch. This was a delivery — of us.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
The job was never a favor. Vane rigged it so Undertow wins either
   way — skims a cut if we pull the heist clean, or takes the
   collateral off Juno if we don't. Ratchet was here to make sure of
   it. He doesn't even look sorry.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
I need to ask, Handler — did you know this route was rigged when you
   sent us in, or did you just need it to be over? Either answer
   changes what I do in the next ten seconds.

choices.text: "Go after him. Don't let him walk with our money."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Let him go. Take what we've got and move to the meet."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Forget the cash. Find out who Ratchet actually answers to."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Cover the gap. Whatever it costs, whoever we owe."
choices.speaker: player

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Caught him at the water's edge. Got most of the money back, and
   something better — a chip off his rig with Vane's fingerprints all
   over the setup. He's not talking. Doesn't need to. This talks for
   him.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: FLAG SET: HAS_LEVERAGE

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Lost him in the market stalls. Fistful of nothing, worse mood. We're
   walking into the den lighter than we've ever been, Handler.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Copy. Not chasing ghosts. We've got what never left my hands — and
   it isn't fifty thousand. We're going in with a partial payment and
   whatever's left of a plan.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: TRACE IN PROGRESS...

messages.speaker: data
messages.text:
TRACE COMPLETE: Ratchet's contract traces to Coral Vane — dated
three weeks prior. Predates tonight's 'job offer' entirely.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Three weeks, Handler. He set this up before Juno even missed a
   payment. Vane's whole 'work off the debt' line was theater from
   the start.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: FLAG SET: HAS_LEVERAGE

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Made a call. Traded a favor to cover the shortfall — it's done,
   it's covered, and it's a debt with somebody else's name on it now.
   We fixed tonight, Handler. We didn't fix the problem.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: FLAG SET: NEW_DEBT_OWED

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: RETURN — UNDERTOW DEN — TIDE: RISING

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
We're back where we started, Handler. Water's coming up through the
   grates now instead of keeping us out. Vane's waiting. So's Juno.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Juno's talking before Vane even opens his mouth. Says she took the
   loan because deep-sector work pays triple and she wasn't going to
   sit topside and watch us cover her rent forever. Wants that said
   out loud before whatever happens next happens.

choices.text: "Pay him. All of it. We're done here."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Pay him. All of it. We're done here."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "Put the leverage on the table. See if he backs down."
choices.speaker: player

choices.text: "We take Juno by force. Right now."
choices.speaker: player

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text: Money's counted. Vane's satisfied — publicly, anyway. Juno's free.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
He's still got that look from when you threatened him, though. This
   isn't over just because the math is. We're marked, Handler, paid
   or not.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: DEBT CLEARED — UNDERTOW: MARKED (SOFT TARGET)

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text: Money's counted. Vane's satisfied — publicly, anyway. Juno's free.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: DEBT CLEARED — UNDERTOW: SETTLED

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Put the proof on the table. Vane's face doesn't move, but his
   crew's does — nobody in this den wants Vane's contract habits
   going public. He's backing off. Says the debt's forgiven. I don't
   believe the smile, but Juno's walking out of here.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: DEBT FORGIVEN — VANE: PRIVATELY HOSTILE

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
He called it. Says go prove it to somebody who matters — and then
   his crew stopped pretending this was a negotiation.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT — FORCED

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Stalling him — every second we hold this conversation is a second
   closer to backup.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: INCOMING — FRIENDLY CONTACT

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
There. Vane's doing math on numbers he didn't expect to see walk
   in. Changes the conversation fast.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: STANDOFF — NEGOTIATED EXIT, BACKED BY FORCE

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: HOSTILE ENGAGEMENT — FULL

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text: No more talking, Handler. Going in for her.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: COMBAT RESOLVED — DEN CLEARED

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
She's out. Undertow's not going to forget this — we just made an
   enemy with a long memory and a short fuse. But your sister's
   breathing, Handler, and the regulator's still where it belongs.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: DEBT ERASED — UNDERTOW: STANDING ENEMY

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CRITICAL — OBJECTIVE COMPROMISED

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
Handler— I couldn't get to her in time. They took the regulator out
   on the spot. No anesthetic. Exactly like Vane said they would.

messages.speaker: enforcer
messages.text:
She's gone, Handler. I'm sorry. I need orders, because right now I
   don't have any of my own worth giving.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: CONNECTION HOLDING — STANDING BY

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: E N D   O F   S C E N A R I O
